contributions.description: Dedicated contribution run receipt; ordinary submissions never write the knowledge layer

submission.description: Digest of the received user submission; with system_input, digest of that action detail.input instead; legacy production uses the run record digest

system_input.description: System-delivery input action; detail.input contains the exact canonical input whose digest is submission; never a user receipt

path.description: JSON Pointer into the call arguments; for submit_result, into the submission

errors.description: every code that kept the submission from being accepted, item-level refutations with their fixes and rounds left, and items the submission did not cover

criterion.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

skip_reason.description: The submitted skipped-item reason preserved verbatim in the result; never inferred from a generic reason code

carried_over.description: the predecessor run fragment this item was carried over from; set only after the Hub checked that the item and the cited content are unchanged (C08 R[4])
